data.exact_reserve_text: Any adjustments to previous reserves for losses and loss expenses estimates are recognised in the period they are determined. data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2018 gross claims outstanding were GBP 1,561.969m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates adverse development on older years (principally the 2016 underwriting year) amounting to a gross strengthening of approximately GBP 29.6m (1.9% of opening gross reserves). The report highlights a high frequency of catastrophe events in 2018 (including Hurricanes Michael and Florence and California wildfires) and a general increase in large individual losses; additionally a significant Reinsurance-to-Close (RITC) transaction for 2015 and prior business was completed in January 2018 which materially affected comparatives and the reserves profile.
raw_causal_phrases: a high frequency of catastrophe events experienced in the year, specifically hurricanes Michael and Florence, as well as another year of devastating California Wildfires, but also an increase in frequency of large individual losses.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Technical provisions note (Provision for claims outstanding: As at 1 January 2018 = GBP 1,561,969k). Prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development table (triangle) - only UW years 2016-2018 are shown due to an RITC transfer of 2015 & prior; the calculation therefore includes only the 2016 column (movement +29,570k). RITC in Jan 2018 materially distorts comparatives and limits broader triangle-based analysis. No explicit single-sentence gross prior-year movement figure was provided in narrative notes; the movement was derived from the gross triangle (confidence 0.8).
